title: Facilitator wellbeing check script
description: A script for the facilitator on sensitive exercises: what to say before the start, check-in questions, signs to watch, the stop and step out rule and follow-up. Wellbeing support is by role and through the organization's own program; the script never directs a player to a real helpline during play.

facilitator.description: Facilitator or wellbeing contact (role or fictional name)

beforeStart.description: Lines to say before the exercise starts
examples: Some of today's material is about suicide and people in distress. All of it is fictional.
You may step out at any time, for any reason, and you do not need to explain.

checkInQuestions.description: Questions to ask at breaks and at the hot wash
examples: How are you doing with the material so far?
Does anyone need a longer break or a quieter room?
Is there anything the group should know before we continue?

signsToWatch.description: Signs a participant may need support
examples: Sudden silence or leaving the room
A personal story that goes beyond the scenario

stopAndStepOut.description: The stop and step out rule, in the facilitator's words
examples: Any person may say "step out" and leave. The facilitator pauses the clock if two or more people leave or if anyone asks.

ifSomeoneIsDistressed.description: What the facilitator does, in order
examples: Pause the exercise and thank the person.
Offer a quiet space and a colleague to sit with them.
Use the organization's employee support program for follow-up.
Name one thing that helped you stay steady today.
The support program card is in your packet.
